verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is a hosted payments and agentic-commerce service, so whether its source is published under an open license is a fair question to ask. The pack shows no such release. The only GitHub item (adyen-openapi) holds API definitions for Swagger tooling, not product source, and no license is stated. The rest of the pack covers proprietary hosted APIs, docs, and an MCP server, none of which is shown to be open-source.
